newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National gains after weekend report.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National gains after weekend report.

text.p: Shares in Abbey National Plc rose to a record high on Monday after a report in the Sunday Times said there was talk that the banking group was poised for another acquisition as the UK financial services sector consolidates.
The stock was up 6-1/2p at 670 by 0909 GMT in volume of 581,909 shares, surpassing the previous peak of 665p set Friday.

The Sunday Times highlighted a rise in Abbey National shares since the demutualisation of the former building society and said the company was "hungry for fresh growth" under the leadership of chief executive Peter Birch.
The newspaper said any move was likely to be in the life insurance and pensions sector.

As well as other mutually-owned groups, it said there were quoted companies that might be interested in joining "what looks like being a winning player in the rapidly consolidating market for retail financial services."

A spokesman for Abbey National said Birch had made it clear in the past that he aimed to expand the company's life business, whether through acquisition or otherwise, but said there was nothing in the pipeline and the company's policy anyway was not to comment on market speculation. -- David Holmes, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
